title: RunManifest v1
description: Cross-stage run manifest linking a RunContext to its stage output artifacts. Schema version 1.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema version.  Bump whenever the contract changes.

run.description: Identity and timing metadata for this pipeline run.

artifacts.description: Logical artifact key → relative filesystem path.  Stage-specific keys (dataset_id, feature_set_version, etc.) are stored here rather than as top-level fields.

parent_run_id.description: run_id of the upstream run this run is derived from (e.g. dataset_build that fed this backtest).

run_context.title: RunContext
run_context.description: Immutable run-level identity and timing metadata shared by all pipeline stages.

run_type.description: Pipeline stage that produced this run.

config_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the serialized config payload used for this run.

git_commit.description: Short Git commit hash at the time of the run, or null when unavailable.

started_at_utc.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the run was created.

completed_at_utc.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the run completed, or null if still in progress.
